biography.value:
Description

A large crab monster that looks almost as if it was made of ice, one of its claws extremely large compared to the other. There's something almost hypnotic about its eyes… - Imban

Defense

AC 16, touch 9, flat-footed 16 (+7 natural, -1 size)

hp 84 [120] (5d8+20)

Fort +8, Ref +1, Will +4

DR 5/magic

Immune death effects, ice, mind-affecting effects, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, sleep; Resist water 10

Weakness lightning

Offense

Speed 30 ft., swim 20 ft.

Melee 2 claws +9 (1d6+10 plus grab)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Confusing Gaze, constrict (1d6+10), Giant Blade, Icy Foam, Tornado

Statistics

Str 30, Dex 11, Con 18, Int —, Wis 16, Cha 2

Base Atk +3; CMB +14 (+18 grapple); CMD 24 (36 vs. trip)

Skills Perception +4, Swim +18; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

SQ Extreme Durability, Water Dependency

Ecology

Environment arctic

Organization solo or with 2 desert sahagin warriors

Treasure triple

description.value: Every 1d4+1 rounds, a snow crab may lock eyes with a single target within 30 feet as a standard action, driving it to confusion. The target must make a DC 15 Will save or suffer the Confused status effect for 1d4 rounds. This is a mind-affecting effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).

effect: Mind-affecting. Single target confused for [[1d4]] rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).

description.value: A snow crab has double hit points and maximum rolls on its hit dice.
Every 1d4 rounds, a snow crab can make one claw attack as a standard action for 2d6+20 damage that cannot begin a grab.

effect: One claw; cannot start a grab.

description.value: 3/day as a standard action, a snow crab may spew forth icy foam at a single target within 35 feet as a ranged touch attack (+2), dealing 3d6+8 ice damage on a successful hit.
3/day as a standard action, a snow crab may spew forth tornado-force winds at a single target within 35 feet as a ranged touch attack (+2), dealing 3d6+8 wind damage on a successful hit.
Crabs can survive out of the water for 1 hour per point of Constitution. Beyond this limit, a crab runs the risk of suffocation, as if it were drowning.
